Tagcast 0.20.0 expands browsing and playback while keeping the reviewed metadata
editing workflow. Standalone desktop downloads include Python and dependencies;
the main interface stays in your browser.

## Browse your collection

- New **Track artists, Composers, Genres and Release year** overviews show album
  and track counts. Choose a card to browse its matching albums, then open an
  album to play or edit it. Multi-disc sets stay together.
- Genres include main and additional labels as stored in iBroadcast. Release
  year uses the track year, falling back to the album year; missing years have
  an **Unknown year** group. Genre names on an album link to matching albums.
- **Favourites** use iBroadcast's native track ratings. Hearts on album tracks,
  search results and the player add rating 5 or clear it to 0. Replacing a lower
  rating requires confirmation; every write is checked against iBroadcast and
  read back. The Favourites page supports search and pagination.
- The player links to the album artist and album. A third line appears when
  the track artist differs and opens albums featuring that track artist.

- **Now playing** shows a large cover and the play queue. Add individual tracks
  or entire albums without interrupting playback. **Clear queue & stop** stops
  audio and removes all queued tracks. The queue stays in this browser session.
- **Decades** offers random album discoveries for periods such as 1980s and 2020s.
  Use **Surprise me again** for another selection; Back preserves your selection.

## Interface and history

- A more compact sidebar, aligned navigation icons and a mobile hamburger menu
  keep all pages and connection settings accessible.
- Clearer album sorting includes both alphabetical directions and track counts.
- A simpler **Live** indicator and a red trash button with an icon make status
  and actions easier to distinguish; trash still requires review and confirmation.
- **Clear history** removes this browser's history and Undo information after
  confirmation. Export a copy first if needed. It does not revert saved changes.
- Artwork Undo no longer offers to restore an image when there was no previous
  image. Deferred read-back results no longer overwrite an artist image Undo.

## Update notifications

Tagcast checks GitHub for a newer stable release at startup, at most once a day.
A notification opens the release page and downloads; installation stays manual.
Use **Sources & keys → Tagcast updates** to check immediately or disable automatic
checks. No account credentials or library data are sent to GitHub.

## Downloads and updating

- **macOS:** `tagcast-0.20.0-macos-arm64.zip` for Apple Silicon, or
  `tagcast-0.20.0-macos-x64.zip` for Intel. Extract `Tagcast.app` and move it to
  Applications.
- **Windows:** extract `tagcast-0.20.0-windows-x64.zip` and open `Tagcast.exe`.
- **Linux:** extract `tagcast-0.20.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` and run `./Tagcast` inside
  the extracted `Tagcast` folder.
- Each package includes a desktop launcher, a separate CLI and license notices,
  with a companion SHA-256 checksum. Windows/Linux executables must stay with
  their `_internal` folder.

**Stop the old Tagcast before starting 0.20.0**; otherwise the new launcher opens
the already-running server. Account settings, tokens and cache remain in
`~/.tagcast/`, or your configured `TAGCAST_HOME`. Your music files are never changed.

Source installations remain supported with Python 3.11+ or uv. See the
[native build guide](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/blob/v0.20.0/docs/native-builds.md)
for checksums, CLI usage, platform requirements and unsigned-app instructions.

Playback does not report plays or Last.fm scrobbles. Favourites are separate
from metadata History/Undo.
